note: Per-shot xG from the BSD shot map (100% coverage 2025/26). big_chances are DERIVED from shots with xg >= 0.18 — fitted against the real club-level field big_chances over 748 club-matches (MAE 0.746, r 0.774). The PER-PLAYER fields big_chance_created/missed EXIST in the API but are ALWAYS NULL and are therefore NOT here. In the box = pos.x <= 17; BSD x is a share of the FULL pitch (105 m), A DIFFERENT scale from ESPN (half pitch) — measured, not carried over. Assists use the OPTA definition and are ~29% fewer than FPL assists (FPL awards one, for example, for winning a penalty) — they are for comparison, not a replacement for the FPL figure.
